segments.text: Today's weather is just great.
You're telling me.
It's great.
Weather like this...
Shall we stop for something to eat afterwards?
Yes.
Something to eat.
Hey.
No food is permitted when riding in Betty, but this is Yoon-pal's car.
On a dark desert highway,
Cool wind in my hair...
What just happened?
Have we just had a car accident?
This is merely one exciting episode in an otherwise boring life.
The car is a mid-sized sedan.
The driver, a male in his early twenties.
The car is most certainly his father's.
Once we leave the car, don't use honorifics from the start.
Everyone, the back of your necks.
Exit the car.
Oh, my waist...
Oh, my third cervical vertebra.
My teeth.
Ah, my knee.
Do you know who we are?
Our collective social status is capable of shaking the very foundation of South Korea.
What has Korea come to that a disruption in traffic can occur in a law governed country?
Just one moment please.
I need to make a call.
A call.
How insufferable...
Hello.
This is Attorney Choi.
Chief Justice, I've been involved in a car accident...
Is this the National Police Agency?
Please connect me to the Police Chief.
If you tell him it's Im Tae San, he'll know who it is.
Honey, it's me, I've had an accident.
Beginning with the highest authority, make a round of calls for me.
Sorry to disturb you, is this the National Forensic Service?
Please find Doctor Yoon Ji Hyung for me.
Yes, Chief Justice.
My injuries are not severe, but...
There is only some stiffness at the back of my neck right now,
but with car accidents the effects are never immediately known.
What?
Doctor Yoon Ji Hyun has passed away?
What is this?
He's trying to compete with us?
Hello, is this the insurance company?
At International Crossroads.
It was I who rear-ended them.
Yes, it was my fault.
Yes.
I'll be waiting then.
I'm really sorry.
They say they'll be here in ten minutes.
Were you injured very severely?
What good weather today...
National Police Agency.
Do you even know what the Police Chief looks like?
Speak for yourself.
And you, what were you looking for sister-in-law for?
That's because to me, my wife is my highest authority.
What?
"National Forensic Service"?
That was the only thing I could think of to vary the professions.
Why are these ten minutes passing so slowly?
It's not like we didn't know the insurance company should be called after an accident.
On that day however,
we employed the old-fashion means of treating a youngster in his twenties,
that we ourselves despised in our twenties.
If it were you,
who had complicated a matter that could have been easily resolved with common sense,
or made a bluff out to be of substance,
what is regrettable,
is that you might already have become the old-fashion people you once scorned.
Or a 'mister'.
Or an old man.
A Gentleman's Dignity
Episode 18
Why is your phone turned off?
Me Ah Ri is leaving the country.
She's at the airport.
She's just sent me a text.
Her cellphone has already been deactivated.
Are you just going to let her go like this?
Hey!
Me Ah Ri is returning to the United States.
She's leaving today...
It seems you already know.
If you leave now you might still be able to see her.
If you step on it that is.
She might not have gone through security yet.
She's not so assiduous.
She might even miss the boarding time, what with shopping at the duty-free stores.
She might even be arrested at the security checkpoint,
for carrying lethal weapons or narcotics.
She might meet a man carrying the exact same bag, and in the moment their eyes meet...
She might still be waiting for you.
You guys go on back.
I have a trial tomorrow.
Fool.
The trial may be tomorrow,
but Me Ah Ri is leaving now.
If my brother finds out...
I love you, Im Me Ah Ri.
I'm sorry I've let you suffer all on your own.
For such a belated confession, I apologize.
You're not going anywhere now.
I won't ever let go of you again.
Oppa.
My coming here was not to prevent you from returning to the U.S...
It was to ask you to stay by my side.
From now on, I will confront my heart with no misgivings.
From this point on, you need only trust me.
I will take care of everything.
Although this will not be an easy road to walk, will not be simple,
I will definitely not release your hand again.
I will never...
leave you to cry alone again.
Where are you?
I'm at the parking lot of your cafe.
All right.
I'll be waiting for you.
Why doesn't he wash his car?
You've come?
Have you had dinner?
I haven't eaten yet.
I was the one who didn't let her go.
We're coming in now.
Come in.
Let's sit down and talk.
You...
How could you...
Choi Yoon Pal, how could you?
I'm sorry.
If I let her go now, I feel as though I'll have lost her forever.
Then, she should be lost to you.
What am I suppose to do?
Is one apology from you,
suppose to make everything all right?
Im Me Ah Ri, aren't you going to stop crying?
If you want to yell at someone, direct it at me.
I will take the full blame.
Choi Yoon Pal.
I've thought this over a thousand times.
Yet each time the answer was no.
I did my utmost to suppress the thought of it,
but when I heard that Me Ah Ri was leaving,
my world collapsed around me.
Only in that moment,
did I realize that this wasn't a problem that could be solved with evasion.
That it wasn't a problem forbearance could fix.
I should have recognized the feelings in my heart much earlier on.
I'm sorry.
For constantly leaving Me Ah Ri in tears.
I will cherish her.
I will cherish Me Ah Ri all my life.
Tae San...
This is my first and last request of you.
Forgive me, just this once.
Are you...
prepared to lose me?
Im Me Ah Ri,
is this your so-called happiness?
Oppa, please forgive me.
Haven't I forgiven enough?
I regret so much now.
I never thought that the two of you would do this to me.
It is my own foolishness.
My own lunacy.
Oppa!
From today onwards,
the two of you are lost to me.
Im Me Ah Ri, leave.
This is no longer your home.
Nor am I your brother.
Oppa...
Oppa...
Oppa...
That foolish girl.
She's normally so insolent and defiant.
Why would she leave as she was told this time?
If she was so obedient, why was she always so perverse with me?
That is ingenuity on her part.
Do you think the two of them met?
Did he even go to her?
I give one point to that he went for her, two to that they met.
Why?
Because I am a man who once lost then found a certain person again.
The feeling that you've lost your everything, I've experienced it before.
Once you've fallen in love, you can't even apply your own hand cream.
You can't.
What time is it now?
Why haven't we heard from him yet?
You never did anything like this when you and sister-in-law were dating?
Wanting to do everything for her.
Worrying over her doing anything on her own.
I become so enraged when this woman eats alone.
I mean, if I don't feed her, how does she eat?
I'm sorry, I suddenly feel nauseous.
Seriously!
If this goes on, you'll be kissing her window next.
A perfectly normal person, kissing through someone's window!
How did you know that?
Eh?
Oh!
It's Attorney Choi.
Hello?
Now?
It must have been a difficult decision to make.
It's embarrassing, the state I'm in...
Not at all.
In all the time I've known you, you seemed the suavest today.
How can a person who has heavily burdened a friend be suave?
Speaking as someone who has once escaped from such a burden,
I can very conscientiously tell you that...
in the beginning,
I also felt that that burden was unbearably heavy,
of such a weight that I could not move a single step.
Then at one point, I had an epiphany.
Ah.
That burden was actually the weight of my heart.
However much I loved, however much happiness I felt,
the heavier that burden became.
I was actually that deeply in love with him.
If only Tae San can draw that same conclusion.
He will.
Don't worry.
Also, there's something I want to say to you.
Although it's a little late in coming, I still want to thank you.
What for?
I found out.
The four of you were the ones who came to the cafe to help me.
The one who helped resolve my legal dispute, was you.
Speaking of which,
I think they might contact you.
If they do, then please let me know.
I worry that the four of you will inconvenience yourselves on my behalf.
If they contact me, I'll give you a call as your consulting attorney.
It's the least I can do for you since you're taking care of Me Ah Ri.
Then, I'll be ever so grateful.
Anyhow, how did you know that it was we who went there?
You broke some things, didn't remunerate, and left just like that.
Ahh...
Your help is one thing, the money is another.
I intend to recoup it back from each of you equally.
If Tae San refuses to acknowledge you and Me Ah Ri though,
should Tae San be the one to compensate me in full?
What?
Yoon stopped you from leaving?
Does your brother know?
I went home with Yoon oppa, but he threw me out.
He said he won't acknowledge me as his sister anymore.
So you left just because he told you to?
What else could I do?
He was in such a fury.
How could you just go off like that, leaving Tae San all alone?
You'll be fine here on your own, right?
Lock the door and sleep well.
Thank you.
You have nothing to be thankful for.
You take care of your man, I'll take care of mine.
I'll tell him that you're here.
He's probably very worried about you.
I'm here.
Where are you?
You haven't turned on any of the lights.
Are you all right?
Me Ah Ri...
is at my house.
It's all right.
It'll be all right.
That awful girl, doing this to her own brother...
Im Me Ah Ri, I am definitely going to punish her.
She's dared to make my man cry?
Does she want to die?
Honey, I'm home.
I haven't been able to reach you all day.
You said to meet you in the parking lot, then you never showed.
Honey, today, Yoon and Me Ah Ri...
Went to a motel?
Motel?
They even went to a motel?
When?
Do I look like I'm joking around with you?
You went to a motel, Lee Jung Rok.
Me?
I did?
Really, you...
What would I go to a motel for?
Ah, that's right.
Tae San had to leave for Chuncheon on a business trip in a haste.
I went to deliver some of his clothes to him.
So you can even lie without blinking now?
Figures.
It's about time your acting improved.
Here you go accusing an innocent person again.
You were asking this at the party, too.
It's true.
If you don't believe me, then ask Tae San.
You've already accorded your statements?
How can you act so shamelessly?
What statements?
I'm going to lose it soon.
I have done such things before, so I see your point.
But I really haven't this time.
Me Ah Ri!
You can ask Me Ah Ri.
She was the one who asked me to go.
Are you trying to buy time?
How am I suppose to call her when she's on a plane to the U.S.?!
Me Ah Ri didn't go to the U.S.
Yoon held her back.
Anyhow, call her.
Call her right now.
You think I won't?
You're really going to call?
You'll embarrass yourself in front of Me Ah Ri.
Let go.
Then I'll embarrass myself this once.
It's Min Sook unni.
There's something I'd like to ask you.
Your manager says he went to Chuncheon on your request.
Is this true?
Yes.
I had a fight with my brother, so I asked Rok oppa to go for me.
Why?
Is Rok oppa not back yet?
It's nothing.
I understand.
What did Me Ah Ri say?
It's true, isn't it?
What is it?
Me Ah Ri didn't admit it?
That rascal, there are some things that can't be joked about.
It's true.
She said...
She asked you to go.
Then, why are you crying?
You're embarrassed?
I can't do this.
I really can't do this anymore.
Let's divorce.
Here you go again.
You're always hanging 'divorce' on your lips.
If you're embarrassed then just say so.
Why keep mentioning a divorce?
If you say it again I really will be angry.
I'm going to bed.
Is school all right?
Is it fun?
School obviously isn't as fun as an amusement park.
Have you made many friends?
I have made one at least.
You've made a friend?
What's his name?
Kim Dong Hyub.
Has initiative.
Very manly.
That's the kind of person I know him as.
He doesn't study very well though.
Did you consider making other friends?
Was Uncle Jung Rok a good student?
What are your favorite times?
Excluding lunch and break times of course.
The minute prior to lunch.
The minute prior to breaks.
Those are the moments I like best.
Does that include the moment before meeting your birth father?
I'm tired.
I'm going to sleep now.
You've left your girl with my girl.
Yes.
She was thrown out by Tae San.
Really?
Your face is unmarred, so you must not have been hit by Tae San.
Not today at least.
Do you remember?
When Me Ah Ri was in elementary school,
a boy in her class hurt her forehead.
Tae San went into a terrible rage.
At that boy's house,
he asked, "Do you know who my Me Ah Ri is?"
"She's going to grow up to be Miss Korea.
What are you going to do about this?"
Of course I remember.
I was with him.
It wasn't because of that scratch on her forehead though.
It was because she was too short that she couldn't try out for Miss Korea.
But why are you mentioning this?
He made such a fuss over a minor injury to her forehead.
Yet I, have essentially ruined Me Ah Ri's life.
From Tae San's perspective, this is a betrayal.
Can he ever forgive me?
Why is this love so akin to war?
How can I help you?
I'm fine.
Take Tae San's side in this.
I should be made to suffer.
Me Ah Ri is Tae San's everything.
You've had a very long day.
Rest.
Have Team Leader Choi prepare for the Loft Village presentation run-through.
Be ready in ten minutes.
Yes, Director.
Sorry I'm late.
You don't look like you've slept.
Are you all right?
Didn't you say before that,
if you pretend to be all right, you'll eventually be all right?
How about it?
Am I really going to be fine?
No.
Is that so?
Has Yoon gone to work?
Has Tae San come to work?
He's just sent me a text asking that.
How about I forward it to you and you respond back to him?
With an attitude like that, this won't be an easy matter to handle.
Regarding the problem of Me Ah Ri, I am entirely on your side.
Why?
Yoon asked me to support you.
He said he didn't need it.
That irritates you, right?
You really...
You don't trust me at all.
Should I take this opportunity to kick Yoon out?
Then tell my girlfriend to kick Me Ah Ri out?
Fine.
I'll do that then.
Those two, they need to be out on the street before...
Why bother?
Why not just set them up in a house instead?
I'm going to the Loft Village presentation run-through.
It's fine.
I'll go.
Then, you go on ahead.
Forty different houses of individual styles will share a courtyard in Loft Village.
Each house will reflect the lifestyle of their owners.
A house of light, a pinwheel house,
a house that will serve as the backdrop to their life,
a house with large spaces, and so forth.
Each will be individually themed.
The revival of the courtyard and lofts, will be the revival of family,
as well as the revival of the neighborhood...
Should I start over?
Don't mind Director Im.
He's currently experiencing a family crisis.
I heard what he was saying.
A 'love affair' (similar to pinwheel) house, a house with especially large spaces.
Not bad.
You've done well.
What are you all laughing at?
I haven't been after you for a while, have I?
Interrupt again and you'll settling the accounts for the first half of the year.
It's not bad in general, but it's a little stiff.
There's no humor.
And what is humor?
The delivery of the result of deep observation to the other party.
Right.
Such as the love affair house, the house of large spaces, etc.
That's not called humor.
What is it?
It's 'Omo*!'
Omo.
(*Oh my)
Revise it some more.
Include technical aspects such as heating and A/C as well as a security system.
These are common prejudices consumers used to living in high-rises have against houses.
You have one more day to collate this.
This project's heating and A/C should use the PWS system.
That is all.
Yes!
Our Director Im.
He might appear to be absent-minded, but it doesn't interfere with his work at all.
What do you want for lunch?
I'll buy.
You go eat.
I have an appointment.
With whom?
You...
Yes.
The ring...
I've taken it off.
I'll put this simply.
Supposing you brought back a twenty-four year old girlfriend one day,
I would say,
"Hey, you cradle robber!"
But that twenty-four year old girl is my younger sister.
How am I suppose to understand?
About Jung Ah, as your friend, I see her as a painful wound to bear.
But as a brother, it is a past that is difficult to accept.
Put yourself in my shoes for a minute.
If you were me, would you consent?
I understand your reaction.
I think it's entirely within reason.
However, if you can understand,
then why did you let things reach this point and force me to say such words?
Why?
I'm incapable of giving her up.
I know that I am an audacious bastard.
I also know that you feel as though you've been robbed.
If you know that then why did you do it?
Why did you do it albeit knowing?
Even if I didn't trust Me Ah Ri, I trusted you.
I'm sorry.
But Tae San,
Me Ah Ri has shed tears for someone like me.
Someone as despicable as me.
That's why,
I want to prevent Me Ah Ri from ever crying again.
What about Me Ah Ri's dreams?
Her future?
That Me Ah Ri wants to design bags and fiddle with sewing machines,
I'm actually not in favor of it.
However, it is her dream.
I hope that she can learn more, become ever more skilled,
then ultimately achieve her dreams.
I don't want Me Ah Ri to lose her dreams, either.
Tae San, Me Ah Ri is also a dream of mine.
No matter if she becomes a designer, or anything else for that matter,
I will do everything in my power, to see my dream through.
I'm going to go look at houses.
Do you want to come along?
Isn't Do Jin oppa also going?
You go on and sweetly look at houses together.
I might not be able to fend for myself right now,
but I'm still the eternal cheerleader of your love, Me Ah Ri.
Will you be all right?
Se Ra will give you a hard time.
It's really unexpected.
I didn't think she loved my brother so dearly.
In Se Ra's mind there are only two classifications: enemy or ally.
You're in for it now.
I'm going.
See you later.
Come on in.
The previous occupant was a single woman, so it's very clean.
Will it be the two of you living here?
That's what it looks like to you, doesn't it?
It will be two women, along with a friend of mine.
I'm living with Se Ra again.
This time, I'll be the owner.
So you like that?
That's unhappy news to me.
You...
The rental price is reasonable, so many people come to see this house.
If you like the place, then you should sign the contract immediately.
Before it's taken by someone else.
Feel free to look around.
Thank you.
We look like a newlywed couple, don't we?
How can you dream so ambitiously in the bright light of day?
We resemble more of a couple who is entering their second marriage.
Is it because I have a son that you are reproving me?
I meant that we are both pass the average marriage age.
Who would have thought that you would have an inferiority complex?
A humble charm of this degree is something I should possess.
If I'm too bling-bling then I would be like those leading men in TV dramas.
Sign for this house.
Speaking as an expert, this is the best of the houses we've seen.
Which parts does the expert approve of?
It's the one closest to my house.
How did you manage to suppress this urge before?
With much difficulty so from now on I'll do it whenever I have the chance.
There are two sides to this wall.
As long as one of them is painted boldly as an accent wall...
We'll be done soon.
The entire space will immediately liven up.
You will help with the painting, won't you?
Is such top quality labour for you to misemploy like th....
An insect!
Yi Soo oppa, number one.
What did you say?
Don't you know?
The one who can kill the insects is the oppa.
I'll sign the contract.
Can we return sometime within this week...
for disinfection and the paint job that will enliven the space?
Of course.
This was no simple task.
You didn't stand a chance without me.
Without you I would have finished long ago.
Why carry me when there's a perfectly good ladder standing there?
I didn't expect you to really climb on when I said I would carry you on my back.
I'd put my life as a man on the line to help you.
My back nearly broke.
That would not ultimately bode well for Seo Yi Soo.
Really...
This is sexual harassment.
If the harassed party feels uncomfortable then it's sexual harassment.
Is your expression an expression of discomfort?
It's an expression that is yearning for more.
Seriously.
There's nothing you won't say.
Then I'll do something else.
Did you think that I was the type to hold back?
She has a tendency to draw danger to herself, this woman.
Lie back down.
I'll spare you this time.
How is Tae San doing?
Me Ah Ri...
is doing pretty well.
There's not a crack in his armor.
Concerning Me Ah Ri, he's entirely unwilling to compromise.
I really think that Me Ah Ri is very brave.
Seo Yi Soo is not so simple either.
I suppose.
I'll build a beautiful house for you some day.
Large and spacious, with good lighting.
Well ventilated as well.
A home no one would want to leave.
Where in Canada are your parents?
Toronto.
Even in the heat of summer, cool relief can be found in the shades of trees.
Until when were you all living together?
As soon as I went to college, they couldn't be bothered to stay.
I had actually wanted to study another year.
My mom said, "With your skills, it will be enough."
"We're going to Canada.
You enter college."
My personality is like my mother's.
Very harmonious.
Although we weren't wealthy, we lived very contentedly.
My parents have a very good relationship.
I was always viewed as the hellion.
It was saddening at the time, but afterwards, I knew it to be true happiness.
That was the origin of both your self-confidence and easy leisure.
I also have more than enough confidence, but yours is different from mine's.
Mine was the product of hard work,
yours was a gift from birth.
Those who have had to work for it can recognize those born with it in a glance.
In order to allow oneself to experience defeat.
My childhood wasn't a particularly happy one.
My family was of average means.
Look at me.
Do you know?
Seo Yi Soo's happiness...
has been delegated to me since the third quarter of her thirty-sixth year of age.
As in beginning from this moment forth.
The promise to make you happy, can I honor it anew?
Tomorrow more than today.
The day after more than tomorrow.
You will be happier each day.
I promise you.
I'm going to believe you once more.
This time, I will honor it to my death.
Is this the taxi service?
I'll call you back.
Were you going to take a taxi with that?
I do use the car occasionally.
I was going to do that.
The car's been inspected and even equipped with a spare tire.
It has a low annual fee and has character.
Thank you.
Here.
As for the rest of the money, I'll have it the day after tomorrow because I'm moving.
You drive.
Take me home.
When are you moving?
I've already called a moving company.
You don't have to worry.
Compared to family, a stranger's work is not the same.
A man should help in times like these.
It's not as though I'm a college student moving rooms.
Me Ah Ri is there.
I thought you didn't want to see her.
Where is Me Ah Ri sleeping?
She's either fallen asleep in front of the television on the living room sofa,
or bunking down on the floor in Yi Soo's room.
Don't you cook very infrequently?
Why are you worrying?
The takeout booklet offers thirty different choices from Korean to Mexican.
Have you spoken with Yoon?
I made my position clear.
He made his clear.
Considering only Me Ah Ri's life,
this may be the happiest moment of her life.
I was thirty-six years old when I met the man of my life.
She met hers at twenty-four.
She'll have...
twelve more years of happiness than me.
Don't take her side in this.
Even if she were thirty-four, I would still think it lamentable.
She's only twenty-four.
I've already yelled at her many times.
Should I go reason with Attorney Choi?
What should I do?
Tell me anything.
I'm a graduate of a sports university.
They're all dead meat.
Do Jin will probably come, and I'll have Jung Rok come help.
Have a good move.
Don't worry.
We're here.
You've come?
Come here, you.
Hey.
Even magpies can be counted on to be grateful.
How could you leave for the U.S. without a word of thanks?
I didn't end up leaving anyways.
Teacher, Do Jin oppa is here.
What did you change for?
Wouldn't a dress be inconvenient?
No, not at all.
Something just got on my clothes.
Teacher, you're so fierce.
If this weren't moving day, wouldn't you be dressed in a bikini?
What is this?
Who do you think you're talking to?
You have Kim Do Jin backing you up, don't you?
Because of a certain someone, Tae San can't even come to see me.
I'll go organize the clothes.
I said it's not.
This is my usual attire.
Why not just wear clothes you go out in?
How is the unpacking coming along?
I'm starting now.
Come with me.
What should I do?
I used to love playing with these.
Please take your time.
We will.
Those uniforms really suit you.
Why is there a book here?
Switch positions with me.
Who told you to wear such clothing?
For someone who so casually kills insects,
do you think that floral print suits you?
A bug!
None of your business.
Back to work.
What number is it?
What?
Of 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, which is it?
Is it my favorite number three?
Your number three can go jump in a lake!
Number two?
Ahh.
Number two.
Yesterday?
Kitty.
You're wearing a very amused expression.
Why is that?
My mind was just wandering.
I only moved a few things.
My nails are all broken.
Mine as well.
When are we going to eat?
You're hungry?
We've toiled all day.
How can I not be?
Tae San says he isn't hungry.
He says he has no appetite.
I'm also uneasy and perturbed.
I just don't make it apparent.
Then show it a little.
It's entirely indiscernible.
Have you seen Attorney Choi since that day?
We speak on the phone every day.
He came by a few days ago.
There's nothing we can do until my brother calms down.
Please don't move.
Will this take very long?
She says she's hungry.
It won't.
This is a fast-drying nail polish.
It'll be very quick.
Didn't you see Tae San a few days ago?
How is Tae San?
Director Im!
Good ball!
What is it?
What are you doing here?
The move went well.
The room is a bit small, but they shouldn't have a problem with two women living there.
Me Ah Ri's made herself at home.
Me Ah Ri...
is very worried about you.
Since when?
We've brought some salves.
Do you want the stick-on kind or the spray?
Want to go to the sauna?
I'll scrub your back for you.
We'll always be here for you.
Don't you know?
Honestly...
